title: Loop-safe Co-Session hook delivery
summary: Use safe event boundaries, telemetry-only Stop hooks, and serialized per-participant receipts to prevent cross-CLI notification loops.
hint_triggers: Co-Session hooks should join on SessionStart, pull new handoffs on user input and supported tool completion, and release leases only on SessionEnd. Stop must not emit continuation instructions; skip recursive Stop invocations before telemetry. Persist delivery receipts separately from explicit acknowledgements. Read pending handoffs inside the same lock as receipt updates: an outside snapshot can erase a newer delivery receipt and cause repeats. Suppress self messages, preserve user hook commands during regeneration, and let native CLI trust control activation. Delivery remains best-effort, so the pending handoff list is canonical. Validate repeated events, concurrent delivery interleavings, batch overflow, separate CLI instances, and compiled hook stdout. Run test leak checks without concurrent owner evidence writes.
